[[File:Tele Group Barbarian icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Tele Group Barbarian''' teleports the caster along with anyone within a 3x3 square area (including standing on the player's square) to the [[Barbarian Outpost]] north-west of [[Ardougne]]. Players must have '''Accept Aid''' turned on in order to be teleported by this spell. A window will pop for the person being teleported asking them if they wished to be teleported. As with all [[Lunar spells]], the quest [[Lunar Diplomacy]] must be completed to cast this spell.
